title: find_live_row_for_slot errors map to 500 in do_skip but are swallowed into 409 in create_skipped_slot's re-read
evidence:
do_skip:
      case find_live_row_for_slot(db, app_uuid, slot) {
        Error(_) ->
          response_helpers.json_error(
            error_code.ServerError,
            "Couldn't skip that reference. Give it another go.",
            500,
          )
create_skipped_slot:
        Ok(False) ->
          case find_live_row_for_slot(config.db, app_uuid, slot) {
            Ok(Some(row)) if row.status == "skipped" ->
              json_ok(json.object([#("skipped", json.bool(True))]))
            _ ->
              response_helpers.json_error(
                error_code.Conflict,
                "This reference changed state. Refresh and try again.",
                409,
              )
          }
detail: Same Result-returning helper, two call sites: do_skip maps Error to 500, but the re-read's `_` catch-all swallows a DB error into 409 Conflict. The r2 Result-typing fix was applied inconsistently.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit `Error(_) -> 500` arm before the `_ -> 409` in create_skipped_slot's re-read, matching do_skip's handling.
